signup.name: First name
signup.phoneHint: Only used by the studio about your visits.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A short phrase works well.

signup.inviteVisit: Your visit on {{date}} is waiting. Create your account to see it, change it or book the next one.
signup.inviteText: Create your account to see your visits and book the next one.
signup.inviteInvalid: This invitation has expired or was already used. You can still create an account; the studio can link your visits.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.text: We sent a 6-digit code to <email>{{email}}</email>. Enter it below to finish.
verify.loginText: To keep your account safe, confirm your address first. We sent a 6-digit code to <email>{{email}}</email>.
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
verify.notSentText: Your account is saved, but we couldn't send the code to <email>{{email}}</email>. Try again in a minute. If it keeps failing, contact the studio.
verify.spam: Can't find it? Check Spam or Promotions. The code is valid for 10 minutes.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to set a new password.
forgot.codeText: If an account exists for <email>{{email}}</email>, we sent it a 6-digit code (valid for 10 minutes). Enter it with your new password. The email also has a link, if you prefer.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a password you don't use anywhere else.
reset.doneText: For your security you're signed out on all devices. Log in with the new password.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.

oauthErrors.google: We couldn't sign you in with Google. Please try again.
oauthErrors.google_conflict: This email is already linked to another Google account.
oauthErrors.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Please contact the studio.
